anchor_rule: all fields must be sampled before candidate Path publication, at one recorded anchor timestamp; no post-Path trace values
normalization_rule: continuous channel statistics from complete-only train split; fixed physical geometry scales may be specified prospectively; save metadata with checkpoint
missing_rule: every field has an explicit availability mask; critical primary body fields block inference until real-robot parity is established

fields.name: dem_history
fields.unit: height m plus binary valid mask
fields.normalization: scalar height offset only; train-only valid-cell scaling
fields.parity_status: resolution, axis, unknown and timestamp parity pending physical test
fields.source_topic_api: sim height_scanner_eat -> robot_dem; real GridMap adapter

fields.name: relative_goal
fields.source_topic_api: candidate goal metadata / ROS goal and TF

fields.name: candidate_path
fields.parity_status: base/map conversion and timing require hardware check

fields.name: path_geometry
fields.normalization: fixed physical units then train-only statistics
fields.parity_status: shared implementation and floating tolerance test pending
fields.source_topic_api: Path length, maximum curvature, mean absolute curvature, first tangent, final tangent, direct-Path difference

fields.name: path_dem_profile
fields.timestamp: derived from anchor DEM and Path

fields.name: projected_gravity
fields.timestamp: anchor, synchronized with DEM and command

fields.name: base_linear_velocity
fields.clip: prospective sensor validity bounds, not learned from seven groups
fields.simulator_availability: root world velocity converted to base; Critic base_lin_vel term
fields.real_robot_availability: not supplied by current ROS2 bridge payload; odometry integration required
fields.parity_status: unavailable until odometry source and frame/timing are validated
fields.source_topic_api: sim root_state[7:10] plus quaternion; proposed real odometry/TF

fields.name: base_angular_velocity
fields.simulator_availability: root world angular velocity converted to base; Critic base_ang_vel term
fields.real_robot_availability: IMU angular velocity in bridge payload

fields.name: joint_position
fields.real_robot_availability: JointState topic exists but current bridge extracts a subset
fields.missing_mask: 52-dimensional joint position mask; missing blocks primary inference

fields.name: joint_velocity
fields.real_robot_availability: JointState topic exists but current bridge extracts a subset
fields.parity_status: full 52-order coverage, signs and timing unverified
fields.missing_mask: 52-dimensional joint velocity mask; missing blocks primary inference

fields.name: previous_action
fields.normalization: checkpoint action metadata; no post-Path action
fields.real_robot_availability: backend internal action state could expose but current frontend payload does not
fields.source_topic_api: sim ActionManager._prev_action; proposed deployed Actor state API

fields.name: pre_path_controller_state
fields.unit: active flag, s, m/s, m/s, rad/s
fields.simulator_availability: partly in bridge/follower status; not frozen in all 63 anchor records
fields.real_robot_availability: production follower status and last command potentially available
fields.parity_status: optional masked field; requires explicit pre-Path logging
fields.source_topic_api: follower Path-active flag, Path age, last command; future logging schema

dem_only_baseline: allowed as separate baseline, not primary embodiment-aware model
